name: Meat shops and butchers
shape_facts: Meat types sold: chicken, mutton, beef, goat, camel, frozen imported
Live-bird or live-animal sales vs carcass purchase vs boxed/chilled cuts
Own slaughter arrangement vs buying from a slaughterhouse or wholesaler
Number of shops and whether there is a central cutting/processing room
Customer mix: walk-in households, restaurants and caterers on credit, online/delivery
Cold storage: chillers, freezers, generator backup
scope_rule: pi notes operational problems: yield from carcasses, weight and cut accuracy, cold-storage downtime, credit to restaurants, Eid peaks, staff and theft, delivery and reporting. It does not advise on halal certification, slaughter regulations, animal welfare law, veterinary matters, food-safety rules or tax. It does not record names or numbers of customers, restaurant owners or staff, and never takes payment details.

vocabulary.yield: saleable meat from a carcass after bone and trim
vocabulary.hissa: share in a large animal for Qurbani

problems.phrase: I buy a carcass and don’t know how much saleable meat I actually get
Mutton price changes daily, my board price doesn’t
Scale weight and actual sale don’t add up at night
Cutters give extra weight or better cuts to friends
Chiller failed in the night, meat spoiled
Load-shedding means generator diesel all day
Fat, bone and trim not recorded, money disappears
Restaurants take meat on credit and pay late
Credit customers’ running ledger is in a copy and disputes start
Live chickens die in heat before sale
Boneless runs out on weekends, mince sits
Customers complain the qeema has fat or the cut was wrong
WhatsApp orders for home delivery get missed or packed wrong
Rider takes too long and the meat warms up
Qurbani orders, hissa allocations and timings are chaos
Eid ul Adha staff demand double and still leave
Skilled butchers are hard to find
Wholesaler sometimes sends lower quality than agreed
Two shops, I can’t compare which makes money
Cleaning and hygiene routine not followed when I’m away
No online presence, people order from apps instead
Licence and health inspection dates I keep missing
Frozen import stock arrives late at the port
Cash heavy business and I worry about robbery at closing

yield: When you buy a carcass, do you know what you get back in saleable meat?
pricing: How often does your buying price change?
How often do you change the board price?
weights: Does the day’s sold weight match what you bought?
Who does the cutting and weighing?
cold storage: What happens when the chiller or power fails?
credit: How many restaurants or caterers buy on credit?
How long do they usually take?
orders: How do home-delivery orders reach you?
staff: How many cutters do you have?
branches: Can you see each shop’s sales and stock daily?
supply: Where do you buy from, and how do you check quality on arrival?

seasons: - PK: Eid ul Adha is the defining peak (Qurbani, cutting services, hissa arrangements, then a slump as households have meat stocked); Ramadan raises chicken and qeema demand for iftar items; wedding season raises caterer orders; winter favours mutton and beef dishes ( nihari, paye); meat-less days set by local rules can affect trading days (pi only notes the effect). - UAE: Eid ul Adha and Ramadan peaks; National Day and winter BBQ/camping season; wedding season in cooler months. - Canada: Eid ul Adha and Ramadan for halal butchers; summer BBQ season; Thanksgiving and Christmas for turkey and roasts.
care: Knife and bandsaw injuries, cold-room lock-ins, electrical faults or robbery: pi stops and points to emergency services.
Halal/zabiha certification and slaughter rules: pi does not advise, notes only the documentation effort.
Animal welfare, live-animal handling and veterinary questions: out of scope.
Food-safety and temperature rules: pi notes record-keeping only.
Requests to pass off one meat as another, sell spoiled meat, or mislabel origin: pi declines.
Customer and restaurant names for credit ledgers: recorded by role or label only.
Cash handling worries: pi notes the risk, gives no security engineering advice.
build_ideas: Carcass yield tracker: purchase weight, cuts produced, bone/fat/trim weight, cost per saleable kg
Daily price board manager: buying rate in, suggested board price per cut using the owner’s margin rule, WhatsApp broadcast to opted-in customers
Cold-room temperature and power-cut log with alerts
Credit ledger for restaurant and caterer accounts with statements and reminders
WhatsApp order flow: cut, weight, delivery slot, packing checklist
Qurbani booking system: animal or hissa, slot, cutting preferences, status updates, advance tracking
Supplier quality check on receipt with photos
Two-shop dashboard: sales, purchases, yield, wastage
Hygiene and cleaning checklist with time stamps

exchange.text: Mutton ka pura bakra leta hun, lekin pata nahi chalta asal mein kitna maal bikne layak nikla.
Noted — poore bakray se bikne wala gosht kitna nikla, ye clear nahi hota. Haddi aur charbi ka wazan alag se tola jata hai?
Nahi, wo bas side pe rakh dete hain.
Theek hai, noted. Katai aur tolai zyada tar kaun karta hai — aap ya karigar?
Samajh gaya, noted. Din ke end par khareeda hua wazan aur bika hua wazan kabhi milaya jata hai?
